method: tools.mjs verify: each quotation (proposition records, institutional events and document disclaimers) matched against the cached text of its own source after normalising Unicode compatibility forms, quotes, dashes, whitespace and PDF line-break hyphenation; "…" joins fragments that must occur in order. Word limits per quotation (50) and per source (editorial policy). No source in this pack is a dataset source, so no dataset quotations are counted against the budgets. Merge problems (structure, voice and attribution, roles, earliest located, loaded words in statements and qualifications outside quotation marks) are listed separately.
